The picture depicts Wang Xizhi and other people visiting Lanting at the beginning of spring, gobbling and writing poems. At the beginning of the picture, on top of the water pavilion, a man is gazing at four white geese outside the pavilion; after that, on both sides of the winding stream, forty-two people are sitting in order, drinking and writing poems; the servants are running around and active; the wine goblets floating on the water surface are stopping or flowing in front of everyone; at the end of the picture, there is a stone bridge, and several servants are retrieving the wine goblets that are flowing downstream.
